body:
> How much do translations have to match to... be considered "matched"?

Anything above zero, is match. Which means at least language code is equivalent (string might be different, since there are platform specific aliases).

10 is full match. Which means all components are equivalent (but again, strings can be different, since it accounts for default and aliases).

e.g, following two case all full match (10):

```gdscript
compare_locales("zh_Hans", "zh_CN")
compare_locales("iw", "he")
```

A typical use case for `compare_locales` is picking a translation with the highest non-zero score.

```suggestion
	CHECK(td->translate("GOOD_MORNING", StringName()) == "Good Morning");
```

body:
Yes, the value of this method is its ability to remove duplicates. I'll undo this deprecation.

`get_loaded_locales()` were added in 3.2 by #28376 as a workaround of `get_translations()` being missing. 

Duplicates were not removed until 4.4 by #98547. The ability was added not because users were complaining about it, but because I was checking the fact that there could be multiple `Translaiton`s loaded for a single locale :rofl: I regret being so eager to help back then.
Looks like `get_loaded_locales()` from TranslationDomain could also be kept 🤔
